end.parentNote: Harsh practised reading ordered pairs, plotting points, identifying quadrants, and reflecting points across an axis. They corrected the mix-up that (3, 2) and (2, 3) are different points and correctly identified Quadrants II and IV in later examples. They still need practice recognising that points on the axes do not belong to any quadrant; at home, ask them to plot three points and label each point’s quadrant or axis.
